blocks.text:
**Programme dates:** 30 December – 8 January

After Rio, you will travel to Iguazu to see the waterfalls from both sides. The Brazilian side offers sweeping views of the cascades, while the Argentine side takes you much closer to the water. The journey then ends in Buenos Aires, where a city tour connects La Boca, San Telmo, Plaza de Mayo, Recoleta and Puerto Madero. In the evening, a tango show with dinner and wine awaits you.

The programme includes free time, so you can rest after New Year's Eve and between flights without rushing. In Rio, you can spend a day by the ocean or arrange an outing with a local guide on an agreed route. At Iguazu, Macuco Safari and the Bird Park are optional activities. In Buenos Aires, you can explore Tigre, spend a full day in Montevideo or visit a ranch to learn about Argentine gaucho traditions.

The New Year celebrations are centred on Rio, but afterwards the itinerary turns towards nature. Two full days at Iguazu allow you to see the same waterfall system from two different perspectives. Buenos Aires then provides four nights and a more relaxed finale: a city tour, tango and a free day with several excursion options.

This balance matters on a longer holiday journey. The first days allow time to adjust to the time difference and hot climate, a free day follows New Year's Eve, and there are no daily transfers before your departure from Argentina. The itinerary is full of experiences, with pauses built in.
